about: Rugby Union > Jersey tile only (RUGBYV 2026-11-18, the user chose that tile): Tripo model rugby-vneck-jersey-textured.glb (shape only; its painted colours and its own UV atlas are not used). Reference Yellow Images card 14475 (Men's Rugby Kit with V-Neck Jersey; not in the booklet: its colours as Tripo painted them from the card): yellow front panel, V-neck band and hem band; navy back, side panels and shoulder yoke (one piece: Accent), navy sleeves and cuffs; our marks only. Colour edges: the borders of the same garment split by Tripo (rugby-vneck-jersey-parts.glb), smoothed over the model (viewer/tripo-glbparts.mjs). Tile wired by hand (the name 'Jersey' is used by many tiles): config/catalog.php and lib/sports_catalog.dart, the RU Jersey tile's look 'rugbyVJersey'. The kits and every other jersey keep their own shapes.
